# SPF overseas fixtures

Retrieved from the official Santé publique France ODISSÉ API on 2026-11-16.
`*-metadata.json` preserves official metadata responses. `*-sample.json` contains
two unchanged Guadeloupe source records per dataset; the response's total_count
is intentionally reduced to the fixture subset for a complete single-page replay.
These fixture subsets do not assert full history coverage.

Live complete-history capture and its manifest live under
`data/raw/{gp,mq,gf}/spf_odisse_history/`. Metadata and counted paginated responses
are retained there; local outputs and coverage audits live in `data/current/`.
